title: Escape key does not close the modal
assertion: A modal dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) must close when the user presses Escape (WAI-ARIA APG).

consoleErrors: [ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) @ http://127.0.0.1:5173/favicon.ico:0

domProbes.explorerEvidence: After pressing Escape the [role='dialog'] element is still present in the DOM and visible; the modal did not close.

title: Focus is not moved into the dialog when it opens
assertion: When a modal opens, focus should move into the dialog (the dialog itself or its first focusable element, e.g. Close), and on close should return to the trigger.

consoleErrors: [ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) @ http://127.0.0.1:5173/favicon.ico:0

domProbes.explorerEvidence: After opening, document.activeElement is still the 'Open Modal' button (outside the dialog). After clicking Close, focus falls to <body> instead of returning to the trigger.

title: Focus is not trapped within the modal
assertion: While an aria-modal=true dialog is open, Tab/Shift+Tab must cycle only through focusable elements inside the dialog; background controls must be unreachable.

consoleErrors: [ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) @ http://127.0.0.1:5173/favicon.ico:0

domProbes.explorerEvidence: Starting from the Close button, Tab moves focus to <body> (outside the dialog) and Shift+Tab reaches the background 'Open Modal' button; activeElement.closest('[role=dialog]') is null in both cases.

title: Dialog has no accessible name
assertion: A role=dialog / aria-modal=true element must expose an accessible name, e.g. via aria-labelledby pointing at its heading, or aria-label.

consoleErrors: [ERROR] Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) @ http://127.0.0.1:5173/favicon.ico:0

domProbes.explorerEvidence: The [role='dialog'] element has aria-modal='true' but aria-labelledby=null and aria-label=null; the visible 'Modal Heading' (h1) is not associated with the dialog, so it has no accessible name.
